name: rwconfig
description: Syntax highlighting for `rwconfig` files, and checks that the Java code matches what they declare.

commands.title: rwConfig: Check code against the rwconfig file
rwConfig: Test config sources (loads them - opens files, URLs and databases)

rwconfig.file.description: Path to the `rwconfig` file. Empty means look in `src/main/resources/rwconfig`, then `rwconfig`.

rwconfig.sourceRoots.description: Directories of Java sources to check. Empty means find the module that owns each `rwconfig` file, which is what a multi-module build needs.

rwconfig.javaPath.description: The `java` to run the analyzer with. Empty means whatever is on the PATH.
